propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP because undeclared payload keys are discarded before execution.
The handwritten MCP adapter in _mcp_writes.py independently forwards only close_class or assignee, so adding schema fields alone would still lose them at the adapter boundary.
The signed 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the old force-only-CLI policy and establishes parity across all surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with absent certification as the audit signal.

Runtime probes confirmed the root cause: live MCP schemas omitted every reported field, capture stubs received only current kwargs, MCP ref selected HEAD instead of the requested commit, and MCP caused_by closed without the edge while the library produced it.
